name: The Canopy Table
tagline: Elevated dining in the forest — a table among the treetops.
description: The Canopy Table is the resort's signature restaurant, perched 15 metres above the forest floor on a series of interconnected timber platforms. Executive Chef Priya Nair translates the island's ancient spice routes into a contemporary tasting menu that changes with each season's harvest. The wine cellar features over 400 selections, with a particular focus on natural wines from small producers across the Southern Hemisphere.
chefBio: Trained at Noma and Gaggan, Chef Priya brings a rigorous, product-led philosophy to Sri Lanka's extraordinary pantry of spices, seafood, and jungle botanicals.
ingredients: Wild-caught lagoon crab from local fishermen
Heritage organic rice varieties from the hill country
Hand-harvested sea salt from the southern coast
Jackfruit, rambutan & mangosteen from our own grove

name: The Pool Brasserie
tagline: Languid lunches by the water — all-day dining at its most graceful.
description: All-day dining at the main infinity pool, The Pool Brasserie offers a relaxed alternative to the formality of The Canopy Table. The menu celebrates the freshness of coastal Sri Lankan cooking — grilled seafood, tropical fruit platters, artisan sandwiches, and a rotating selection of chilled soups. Cocktails by our in-house mixologist are served sunset-onwards from the adjacent bar pavilion.
chefBio: Marcus grew up in Galle, and his cooking is a love letter to the flavours of the southern coast — bold, clean, and deeply rooted in coastal tradition.
ingredients: Freshly caught yellowfin tuna, line-caught daily
Tropical fruit sourced from partner farms within 50km

name: The Elephant Bar
tagline: Where the golden hour begins — cocktails, stories, and the slow exhale of evening.
description: Named after the gentle giants who roam the forest edges at dusk, The Elephant Bar is the resort's social heart. An open-sided pavilion with 270° jungle views, it serves bespoke cocktails inspired by indigenous botanicals — fresh lemongrass, pandan, wild ginger, and aged arrack. Live acoustic music Wednesday through Sunday. The bar's elephant silhouette motif is drawn by local artist Senali Jayawardana.
chefBio: Rajan trained under Tony Conigliaro in London before returning to Sri Lanka to create the island's most celebrated cocktail programme.
ingredients: Wild harvested lemongrass from resort garden
Artisan bitters infused with cinnamon, cardamom & pepper
